description: Read-only catalog of industrial and tariff support for any Canadian business, including the October 2026 $8.72 billion federal-provincial package and national programs an Alberta firm can ask about: PrairiesCan Regional Tariff Response Initiative, the Strategic Response Fund, the Canada Strong Diversification Fund, BDC Pivot to Grow and its metals envelope, NRCan First and Last Mile Fund, the Critical Minerals Accelerator, and the PSPC Buy Canadian Policy Framework. Ontario-only streams are labeled so an Alberta firm can see they do not apply. workspaceAlberta does not apply for funding or decide eligibility.

company_name.description: Optional company name for the heading.

description.description: What the business does. Any sector, in the business's own words.

industry.description: Optional sector label, such as software, healthcare, steel, or critical minerals.

limit.description: Maximum programs in the applies section (default 12, max 20).

location.description: Where the business is located, such as Edmonton, Alberta. Empty assumes Alberta.

profile.description: Inline business profile used for this call only. Overrides any saved profile. On the shared public endpoint without a subscriber key, this is the way to describe your business.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit capability keywords; derived from description when omitted

description.description: What the business does: products, services, capabilities

industries.description: Optional sector labels for any business. Steel, lumber, aluminum, and construction still work. So do software, healthcare, energy, mining, training, or your own wording. Labels rank matches. They do not hide other contracts.

location.description: Where the business is located, e.g. 'Edmonton, Alberta'

name: match_industrial_support_programs
title: Match industrial and tariff support
